scientific_integrity: Exact two-time diagonal Gaussian model and cumulative posterior trace; finite simulations are cross-checks, not proof. Analytical proof gives bound, attainability as supremum, and exact failure criterion.
scientific_limitations: Two independent states, two perfect coordinate measurements, diagonal dynamics, one selected coordinate per time, cumulative posterior trace. The sharp bound is not claimed for correlated states, longer horizons, noisy sensing, or a final-time-only objective; strict examples persist under small positive measurement noise.
title: Sharp two-step greedy guarantee for noiseless Kalman sensor scheduling
